briefTitle: A Clinical Study to Test if an Investigational Treatment Called BNT326 is Safe and Potentially Beneficial When Used Alone or in Combination With Other Investigational Treatments Such as BNT327, for People With Advanced Malignant Tumors

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have measurable disease defined by RECIST v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohort 1A, 1B, 1C, 1D, 1E, 1F, 2A, 2B, 2D, 2E, 1G and 2F eligibility and prior lines vary significantly by cohort and cannot be expressed as simple single-cohort typed rules.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex multi-cohort inclusion rules with differing prior therapies and lines across specific sub-cohorts.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cohort 1B and 1C: Have advanced (i.e., metastatic or locally recurrent where local therapy with curative intent is not possible) non-squamous or squamous NSCLC.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Eligibility rules are multi-cohort dependent with specific variant, prior line, and therapy criteria depending on the specific NSCLC cohort.
